value.rationale: A natural minimal pair of incident deletions from the complete graph, extending the explicitly published triangle-with-leaf example, produces the first nonzero first homology after a clique perturbation: one deletion yields a forest, while two create \(2n-7\) cycles and \((n-3)(n-4)\) isolated vertices. The complete integral symmetric-group and leaf-swap modules are independent structural information not supplied by counts. It is an all-n natural transition, not an arbitrary finite invariant.
